notes.title: Stop game development
notes.notes:
Dear friends, two months ago I was mobilized to the Armed Forces of Ukraine, so I am unable to continue developing the game. I hope for the war to end as soon as possible and for everyone to return home alive and healthy.
Glory to Ukraine!

notes.title: Electricity update
notes.notes:

Now you have the opportunity to create a power grid and connect automatic machines to it.
